h: Two former senior FBI officials charged over testimony about Hunter Biden laptop
p: Two former senior FBI officials have reportedly been charged with misleading Congress over matters linked to the Hunter Biden laptop story. The charges are allegations and neither man has been convicted.
more: The case is expected to draw sharp political reaction in Washington.
Court dates have not yet been widely reported.
